release_notes:
MAJOR STABILITY UPDATE v1.1.0

CRITICAL FIXES:
1. 200+ Accounts Crash Fix - Tool no longer crashes with large account lists
2. Batch Cleanup Fix - No more false 'Failed' status for working accounts
3. Auto-Start Fix - Auto-start now works with 50+ accounts without blocking

KEY FEATURES:
- Intelligent batch processing (20 accounts per batch)
- Safe cleanup that protects active workers
- Memory controlled at 8GB max per batch
- Process count limited to 120 max
- All seeding settings fully respected
- Warning dialog for manual starts (skipped for auto-start)
- Dynamic resource management based on RAM
- Protected PIDs prevent premature Chrome termination
- 30-minute timeout per batch with graceful handling

IMPROVEMENTS:
- Memory leak prevention (5x faster GC, 10x faster orphan checks)
- Smart worker protection during cleanup
- Accurate status reporting (no false failures)
- Better completion rates for slow accounts
- No interference with other features

TIME ESTIMATES:
- 200 accounts: ~7-8 hours
- 400 accounts: ~15 hours
(Conservative timing for system stability)

SAFETY:
- Only kills finished Chrome processes
- Protects active/slow workers
- Preserves View Account, Livestream, etc.
- Graceful error handling
- User can cancel before starting

This is a CRITICAL stability update with multiple essential fixes!
